# Tiny Swords Free Pack (local runtime dependency)

The local development checkout keeps the four cursor PNGs from `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors` in the pack at:

`F:\Desktop\TowerDefense\Tiny Swords (Free Pack)`

The source PNGs are ignored by Git because Pixel Frog permits use in personal and commercial projects but prohibits redistributing or repackaging the assets. Obtain the pack from its [official page](https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/tiny-swords) before setting up another checkout.

Tiny Swords particle effects were used in an earlier combat implementation. They were replaced by Cozy Chunky effects in ADR-0101 and removed from this checkout.

| Runtime role | Source PNG |
|---|---|
| Default cursor | `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors/Cursor_01.png` |
| Interactable hover | `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors/Cursor_02.png` |
| Invalid action | `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors/Cursor_03.png` |
| Tower placement | `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors/Cursor_04.png` |
